card.name: Word-start letters before a vowel
card.fires_on: A lone capital or lowercase letter such as b, B, N or R that begins a word split into pieces, with the rest of the word following, as in biodiversity, Baja, Ringer's.

modes.label: Split word starts
modes.description: A single letter b or B that opens a word, followed by the rest of the word.

modes.label: Names and terms
modes.description: A single capital letter starting a place or solution name.

card.writes: It suppresses tokens like 'ng' and promotes 'tu' and 'nam', which fits a word start that is not continued by 'ng'.
card.plain: It fires on a single starting letter of a word that is broken into pieces, such as the B in Baja or the R in Ringer's.
